open_points.subject: A2 image preparation failure
open_points.text: Checks run in this order: a first frame above the pixel limit (width times height) fails with `too_many_pixels`, a source that cannot be decoded with `unreadable_image`, and a result above the Portal's read limit with `too_large`.
open_points.question: What outcome applies when decoding succeeds but `ImageOps.exif_transpose`, conversion, thumbnailing, compositing or JPEG encoding fails?
options: Treat every image-library failure before a complete encoded result as `unreadable_image`.
Treat encoding or transformation failures as write failures under A3 rule 5.
Refuse the whole request with a separate refusal or internal error.
open_points.default_guess: Return a failed placement with `unreadable_image` for any source-dependent preparation failure.

witness.initial: A source has a decodable first frame but malformed metadata that makes the orientation operation fail.
events: The caller asks the service to deliver the source.
The service decodes the first frame and then the image-library operation raises an error.
outcomes: The delivery answers `failed` with `UNREADABLE_FILE`, or the request is refused as a whole.

open_points.subject: A2 deterministic JPEG bytes
open_points.text: With one library version one source gives the same bytes.
open_points.question: Does “one library version” include and pin the native JPEG codec, its build options and every other encoder dependency that can affect the bytes, or must the claim be weakened to one fully fixed runtime installation?
options: Pin the complete encoder runtime so the assertion holds across installations.
Guarantee identical bytes only within one fixed installation.
Do not guarantee byte-identical re-encoding; guarantee only the specified pixels and JPEG properties.
open_points.default_guess: Scope byte identity to one fully pinned runtime installation, including the native JPEG codec.

witness.initial: Two supported installations use the pinned image-library version but different compatible native JPEG codec builds.
events: Each installation prepares the same source using the stated operations and arguments.
outcomes: Both installations must produce the same encoded bytes, hash and size.
The installations may produce different encoded bytes, hashes and sizes while satisfying every listed image property.
witness.observer: An operator comparing placement records or stored files across installations

open_points.subject: A6 temporary-file creation
open_points.text: The temporary name begins with the imported `TEMPORARY_NAME_PREFIX` constant and is chosen fresh for each write; the temporary file is created exclusively, never reusing an existing entry
open_points.question: What must happen when exclusive creation finds that the chosen temporary name already exists, including a temporary entry left by a crash?
options: Choose another name and retry until exclusive creation succeeds.
Fail the write immediately using the operation's existing write-failure outcome.
Retry a fixed number of times and then fail.
open_points.default_guess: Choose a new unpredictable name and retry; an existing temporary entry is never itself a write failure.

witness.initial: A crash has left a temporary entry whose name the next write's name generator selects.
events: The service starts a placement or mark.
Exclusive creation of the selected temporary name reports that the entry already exists.
outcomes: The service selects another name and completes the operation.
The service fails the operation even though the destination and state records are otherwise available.

open_points.subject: A2 JPEG encoding arguments
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The fixed JPEG policy values must become imported data-provider constants named in the required form, or remain design facts outside the generated specification.

open_points.subject: A2 compositing background
open_points.text: a white `RGB` image of the same size with its own alpha channel as the mask
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The generated code's fixed compositing colour must be supplied through an imported data-provider constant named in the required form, or remain a design fact outside the generated specification.

open_points.subject: A6 final modes
open_points.text:
`RECORD_MODE`, so neither is executable. A folder the service creates in the binary store has the mode
   of `STORE_FOLDER_MODE`, and one in the state folder that of `STATE_FOLDER_MODE`
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Each constant must be named as the imported `RECORD_MODE`, `STORE_FOLDER_MODE` or `STATE_FOLDER_MODE` constant.

open_points.subject: A6 temporary-file mode
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The literal temporary-file mode must become an imported data-provider constant named in the required form, or remain a design fact outside the generated specification.
